Harry Kane can make England history on Thursday. One more cap would be his 126th, taking him past Peter Shilton's record of 125. He is already England's all-time top scorer.

England face Croatia at Wembley; a point sends them to the Nations League quarter-finals. Ezri Konsa and Marc Guehi are out, Dan Burn and James Hill come in.

Will Kane mark cap 126 with a goal?

fb.caption:
As a boy, Lionel Messi was the smallest player on the pitch. Around ten or eleven, doctors found why: a growth hormone deficiency. He was about 4 ft 2.

The treatment meant daily injections, and his family could not pay for it alone. Then, in December 2000, Barcelona signed him on a napkin and took over the treatment.

Was it the best signing they ever made? Full story tomorrow on our page.
